stories.detail: Back-to-back wipes on holes 17 & 18 - we'll pretend this didn't happen

stories.detail: 3 3-pointers+ scattered through the round - keeps finding ways to score

stories.detail: Hit every outcome on the card - the golf round as a show bag

stories.detail: 3 twos in a row on holes 9, 10 & 11 - starting to look comfortable

stories.title: Finding a Rhythm
stories.detail: 3 twos on the bounce on holes 9, 10 & 11

stories.detail: 3-pointer straight into a 1-pointer on holes 12 & 13

stories.detail: 3-pointer on hole 10, 1-pointer on hole 11

stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s AND 3s - a round that covers all four food groups

stories.detail: Answered every wipe with points next hole - never let one become two
